{{Top|leg}}
The '''harvester fleet''' was the name given to the various [[Boat/Legends|sailing ships]] that operated off the coast of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The ships and crews of the fleet [[Fishing/Legends|fished]] the [[Water/Legends|waters]] off Alanciar's coast for [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]] and other [[Species/Legends|species]].
